notes.title: Faye Falling is 35% Off + New Update!
notes.notes:
The third major update for my game [b]Faye Falling[/b] is out now! The new update features an expanded Challenge Mode, improved backtracking, new secrets, new rings, trial rewards, QOL updates, improved performance, the ability to equip two rings at once, and lots more!

Faye Falling is also [b]35% off for the next two weeks[/b], so make sure to grab it if you haven't yet!

[previewyoutube=Kq-HPECdqn4;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1865750/Faye_Falling/

If you haven't checked it out yet, Faye is very much a spiritual successor to View From Below. It takes everything I did with this game and makes it [i]so much[/i] better. It features 5 endings, 6 bosses (+1 secret boss), 3 gameplay paths, an original soundtrack with 30 songs, and lots more!

More soon,
[i]Jack[/i]

notes.title: View From Below 1.73
notes.notes:
View From Below has been ported over from Game Maker 1 to Game Maker 2. (This took so much time and work, you don't want to know LOL.) While porting, I was also able to fix a rendering issue that would cause black lines to appear between tiles on some displays.

Game saves from previous versions aren’t compatible with the new version- but they won’t be deleted or overwritten, so you can resume old saves whenever you wish by returning to 1.72 through the Steam client. (Select the "2021 Build" from the update branch [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1208760/discussions/0/3877095689968007497/]as per these simple steps[/url].)

You can find the full patch notes below.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[i]Engine[/i]
[list]
[*] Ported over to Game Maker 2
[/list][i]Bug Fixes[/i]
[list]
[*] An issue causing black lines to appear between tiles on some devices was fixed
[/list][i]Game Feel[/i][list]
[*] Doubled the walking speed of the player
[*] Condensed tutorials
[*] Condensed chase sequences
[*] Balanced some evade patterns and spell castings
[*] The shaders and tilesets have been made brighter
[/list][i]Other Tweaks[/i][list]
[*] Removed some settings no longer necessary (ie. the achievement sound as Steam now has that built in)[/list]
[i]PS. A release date will FINALLY be announced soon for my follow up game Faye Falling. ([url=twitter.com/jackastral]Follow me on twitter to see it first![/url])[/i]

notes.title: View From Below 1.7
notes.notes:
The first anniversary of View From Below is quickly coming up this month! I learned so much from making (and launching) this strange, dark little game, that I’m really hopeful and excited about what the future holds.

If you haven’t played it yet, now would be the perfect time, because it’s [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208760/View_From_Below/]currently on sale for 60% off.[/url]

Here's an updated version of the launch trailer:

[previewyoutube=h8th6Gvipbk;full][/previewyoutube]

Before announcing my next game in a few weeks, I wanted to first release one final update for View From Below. (Aside from any future bug fixes if necessary, of course.) It makes *lots* of small tweaks to round off some rough edges, and improve balancing.

[b]Here’s the full patch notes:[/b]

[i]Gameplay[/i]
[list]
[*] Bell’s first chase sequence has been updated with an additional attack pattern
[*] Altered the map design for Rose's third chase sequence with more alternative routes[/list]
[i]Balancing[/i]
[list]
[*] Adjusted some item sell prices
[*] Lowered the damage done in most of the chase sequences
[*] Lowered the Challenge+ bonus damage done in all of the chase sequences[/list]
[i]Visuals[/i]
[list]
[*] Improved the good ending cutscene art with a nicer rain effect
[*] The Soul Gate now scrolls nicely in the tower top area[/list]
[i]General Tweaks[/i]
[list]
[*] Made some small adjustments and fixes to cutscenes, such as some new sound effects[/list]
[i]Dialogue[/i]
[list]
[*] Some dialogue was tweaked to improve flow[/list]
[i]Bug Fixes[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed a small Demon Summoner visual bug
[*] Fixed being able to buy trinkets even when out of inventory space
[*] Fixed Melody's armor and trinket not unequipping fully in some contexts[/list]
I want to give one final thank you to every one who played and supported View From Below- it really means so much to me. I had no idea if anyone would even play it- so the fact that hundreds have is a really cool feeling. (Not too bad for my first go at this :S)

I’m still kicking myself over some launch issues, but I’m really proud of where the game is today. All the feedback I received was so helpful, and I think helped make the game better and better with each of the 6 major updates.

I’ve grown a lot as a developer, and as a writer, these past few months, and I think my next game is really going to show that. I can’t wait to finally show it. You can keep up with me on [url=twitter.com/jackastral]twitter[/url] to see when it's first announced.

I hope you’ll follow me to what comes next.

Goodbye for now,
Jack

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.6
notes.notes:
Hey! I just released a new major update for View From Below. It adds some new features like GamePad rumble, the ability to set GamePad button prompts and in-game online leaderboards, as well as lots of refinement and polish across the entire game, such as new Rose chase sequences, and improved tilesets. Here are the full patch notes:

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Full GamePad support with button label settings, and rumble
[*] Added in-game online leaderboards
[/list]
[b]New Rose Attack Patterns[/b]
[list]
[*] Sequence 1 was remade
[*] Sequence 2; the swords now spin, and spawn closer to the player
[*] Sequence 3; the beams now spawn from Xs, and swords occasionally also spawn
[/list]
[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved screens and menus
[*] Pacing improvements to Chapter 1 and 3
[*] Important fix to balancing to avoid the late-game balance issue
[*] Renamed The Runes of Truth to “The Abyss of Truth”
[*] Improved some jokes
[*] Visual improvements, such as new weather effects and improved tilesets
[*] Made characters refer to the MC as “mortal” instead of “human”
[*] Added the ability to turn Alternative Sync on or off, and a "reset" button
[*] Osseus has a new attack pattern with 2 forms
[*] HP and Mana bars now ease in and out smoothly, and fade to black after the character faints
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed melody’s armor not always lowering the damage she takes
[*] Changed some performance settings to fix lag on the latest Windows update (this update was made quietly pre-patch)
[/list]

If you have any feedback, or run into any issues, please [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/1208760/discussions]let me know in the community forums[/url] or in a comment below.

[b]As usual, here's the trailer once more (I'll be updating it to reflect 1.6 soon):[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d7kOWq6lN7k&feature=emb_title

I'm really proud of the game now, so updates will likely slow down as I shift focus to my next project (I'll announce it soon!)

I really want to thank everyone that has played the game so far- all of your support, messages and feedback has really meant a lot to me. This was the first real game I've ever made, so to have so many people actually enjoy it has been such an amazing feeling.

Be well,
-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much to all of you that have played View From Below so far – it really means the world to me.

The game launched just over 2 months ago now, and thanks to your feedback and suggestions, it's continued to grow and improve, and become the best game it can possibly be.

I'm excited to announce that [i]Update 1.2 was just released[/i], and it contains a bunch of awesome new features:
[list]
[*] Bell's house is now accessible, should you manage to seek it out. In it, you can find out more about the mysterious character, as well as attempt to unlock his giant safe. But what's the combination? And what does it contain? You'll have to explore Below to find out…
[*] Glacies Cliffs now contains 5 hidden "Mana Berry Trees" which were planted by a quirky Mage. Find, pick, and eat from them, to boost your Max Mana stat!
[*] Many tweaks and QoL updates have been made to the game based on player feedback. These include some new menu and window designs, a new attack pattern for the Skelly enemy, and a dozen or so rarer bug fixes.
[/list]

Here's the trailer once more:

[previewyoutube=0AlYpDLNVls;full][/previewyoutube]

I know that there's so much more important things going on right now in this intense, dramatic year. But maybe releasing a game about hope and kindness into it wasn't such a bad idea…

Stay safe out there,
-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks so much to everyone who's played [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208760/View_From_Below/]View From Below[/url] so far! It first released just over a month ago, and it's been really awesome to hear your thoughts on the game, as well as about the secrets you've come across and your theories on the lore.

Today I uploaded [b]a major update[/b] that includes [b]Steam achievements[/b], [b]online community leaderboards[/b] for the minigames, as well as an [b]unlockable New Game+ mode [/b]called "Challenge+" ! I've also previously released smaller updates that have added graphical improvements, the ability to quickly skip evading minigames and much more!

Challenge+ makes enemies harder, items cost more and sell for less, and also includes [b]some mode-exclusive lore[/b]. It's tricky, but not [b]too[/b] tricky- I promise! If you manage to beat it, you also unlock a special achievement. Pretty nifty!

[previewyoutube=0AlYpDLNVls;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks so much for playing VIEW FROM BELOW. I hope the game has meant as much to you, as it's meant to me. If you haven't had a chance to get the game yet, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208760/View_From_Below/]now would be a really good time to play.[/url]

Stay safe out there.
- Jack
